statement: Create src/lib/composer/desk-field.ts, a pure module with no React, DOM or fetch imports, exporting deskFieldPlacement(input) where input is { pathname: string, stationMouths: number, importDraftOpen: boolean, armedSessionTitle: string | null } and the result is { mount: boolean, placeholder: string, reason: string }. Rules: mount is false whenever stationMouths >= 1 (a floor station's own mouth wins) and false on /m/ routes and on the public GS1 resolver routes (/01, /414, /l, /p, /s, /q); otherwise mount is true. The placeholder always names the destination of the next input in words: 'Paste orders to stage' when importDraftOpen is true; 'Scan a carton or type to ask · lands in {armedSessionTitle}' when a session is armed; 'Scan, type or say — ask about this desk' otherwise; on /shipping/orders with no draft and no session it is 'Paste a CSV or a screenshot of orders to stage them'. Write src/lib/composer/desk-field.test.ts with node:test covering: station mouth suppresses the desk mount, /m/ suppresses, a resolver route suppresses, the four placeholder branches, and that reason is a non-empty sentence in every case. Touch no other file.
routerHint: pure desk field placement placeholder destination station mouth presence count /m routes GS1 resolver routes node:test
